by: linz lane (step 8.3, fork of integrator-9d788fb); to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of a LINZ Data Service WFS GetFeature answer (data.linz.govt.nz/services/wfs, outputFormat=json): the property titles (layer 50804), the title owners (table 51564) or the NZGB place names (layer 51681), up to 10,000 rows, attributes only

landmarks: a GeoJSON object with "type": "FeatureCollection" and a "features" list
each feature's "properties" carry the source's key (titles and owners: id; place names: name_id) and its required column (title_no, or name)
titles: title_no, status, type, land_district, issue_date, guarantee_status, estate_description, number_owners, spatial_extents_shared
owners: tte_id, title_no, status, land_district, estate_share, owner_type, prime_surname, prime_other_names, name_suffix, corporate_name
place names: name, status, feat_type, maori_name, land_district, territorial_authority, region, crd_latitude, crd_longitude

signals_note: Landed by registers.linz.capture through the fetch gate, the key in an Authorization header (never in the URL the page is landed under). Asked with propertyName naming the attribute columns only, so no geometry and no address is landed. A page that is not a FeatureCollection, or whose features lack the source's key or required column, is not this shape and is set aside at stage recognise.
notes: Surveyed 2 November 2026: owners 5,745,217 rows (projected 1.79 GB), titles 2,457,581 (0.91 GB), place names 54,735 (0.06 GB), every column asked for present. The owners table is under the LINZ Licence for Personal Data; titles and place names CC BY 4.0.
